newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Purchasing Mgrs say August orders up.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Purchasing Mgrs say August orders up.

text.p: The Cincinnati chapter of the National Association of Purchasing Management said its August report showed a firming in the rate of increase of new orders supported by a slight increase in the rate of production. Employment showed no change after two months of rises, the group said.

Vendor deliveries improved, commodity prices declined and service prices showed no change, indicating that purchasers "should expect better deliveries and should not expect any significant increase in prices... (and) should be able to buy on a more 'as needed' basis," it said.
